verdict.rationale: Sumsub provides webhooks for automatic event-driven notifications and an MCP server that lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations under existing permissions, which supports background/automated workflows, plus Summy AI for plain-language level configuration. However, these are event-triggered or user-invoked integrations rather than fully autonomous, self-scheduling background agents, and there's no evidence of persistent/scheduled autonomous automation or independent corroboration. missing for 10: evidence of truly autonomous scheduled background automations (not just event-webhooks/API), independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's autonomous operation.
